title: The YouTube app for Apple TV is so lackluster because it completely ignores all of Apple's best tools (GOOGL, GOOG, AAPL)
text: The YouTube app for Apple TV is so lackluster because it completely ignores all of Apple's best tools (GOOGL, GOOG, AAPL) By Dave Smith Aug 6, 2018, 1:55 pm 17 pts YouTube completely redesigned its app for the Apple TV earlier this year. YouTube's Apple TV app was updated to be more in line with Google's design language — called "Material Design" — which has been in place since 2014.
